findings: RAFT all-pairs feature correlation is within one image pair (B x HW x HW), with a pooled pyramid and iterative local lookup; not corpus-level approximate neighbor search. Memory grows quadratically in feature pixel count; no measured throughput claim.

RAFT recurrent flow updates detach coordinate guesses each iteration and learn convex upsampling; upsample parameter in forward is unused. Zero iters with test_mode leaves flow_up undefined. Default callers use20 iterations.
Optional alternate CUDA correlation import failure is swallowed; selecting alternate path without extension lacks fallback. Parent get_raft_model explicitly sets alternate_corr=False.
Basic/Small encoders concatenate a pair along batch dimension then split into exactly two equal batches; no arbitrary list/cardinality support. GRU motion features are not image identity embeddings.

Original readFlow uses np.resize on payload: a2x2 flow containing only one vector is accepted by repeating that vector four times. Valid roundtrip and invalid magic controls also pass. No production parser copied.
Sparse resize rejects coordinates x==0 or y==0. Original scale1 control drops full top/left borders on a3x3 all-valid map. Duplicate destination coordinates overwrite; not a confidence aggregation.

Dense augmentation rescales/flips flow vectors with images but random crop upper bound excludes last possible origin; equal input/crop extent can cause randint(0,0) when resize is skipped. Static only, normal dataset assumptions unqualified.
Flow visualization optional clipping uses [0,clip_flow], erasing negative motion; per-image magnitude normalization makes colors unsuitable as exact motion identity.

Bundled dataset module uses top-level utils.frame_utils imports inconsistent with parent root utils.py layout unless standalone path is arranged. Parent model imports RAFT core only; no claim parent inference imports this training module. Dataset pairing commonly relies on independently sorted paths/zip, not identity-validated joins.

executed_controls.method: Unchanged original readFlow/writeFlow and sparse-resize AST bodies, NumPy1.26.4; temporary small files. No Torch/OpenCV/model imports.

limits: 47/73 tracked blobs read; no GPU, RAFT full inference, model weights or upstream training suite execution.
